series: 乔布斯 · 斯坦福毕业演讲
title: 斯坦福毕业演讲 3/5 · 失去与重新开始

paragraphs.chinese: 随着苹果壮大，我们请来一个我认为很有才华的人，与我一起管理公司。最初一年左右，一切都很顺利。
paragraphs.english: Well, as Apple grew, we hired someone—who I thought was very talented—to run the company with me. And for the first year or so, things went well.
paragraphs.cue: Well, as Apple grew, we hired someone—who I thought was very talented—to run the company with me. ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 但后来，我们对未来的看法开始分歧，最终发生了冲突。董事会站在了他那边。于是，三十岁的我出局了，而且人尽皆知。
paragraphs.english: But then our visions of the future began to diverge. And eventually we had a falling out. When we did, our board of directors sided with him. And so at 30 I was out, and very publicly out.
paragraphs.cue: But then our visions of the future began to diverge. ______________________________ When we did, our board of directors sided with him. ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 我整个成年生活的重心一下子消失了，那种打击是毁灭性的。几个月里，我真的不知道该做什么。
paragraphs.english: What had been the focus of my entire adult life was gone, and it was devastating. I really didn’t know what to do for a few months.
paragraphs.cue: What had been the focus of my entire adult life was gone, and it was devastating. ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 我觉得自己辜负了上一代创业者，在他们把接力棒交给我时，我却把它弄掉了。
paragraphs.english: I felt that I had let the previous generation of entrepreneurs down, that I had dropped the baton as it was being passed to me.
paragraphs.cue: I felt that I had let the previous generation of ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 我去见了戴维·帕卡德和鲍勃·诺伊斯，试着为自己把事情搞砸而道歉。我成了一个人尽皆知的失败者，甚至想过逃离硅谷。
paragraphs.english: I met with David Packard and Bob Noyce, and tried to apologize for screwing up so badly. I was a very public failure, and I even thought about running away from the Valley.
paragraphs.cue: I met with David Packard and Bob Noyce, and tried to apologize for screwing up so badly. ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 但我渐渐意识到，我仍然热爱自己做的事。苹果发生的变故丝毫没有改变这一点。我被拒绝了，但我仍然热爱。
paragraphs.english: But something slowly began to dawn on me: I still loved what I did. The turn of events at Apple had not changed that one bit. I’d been rejected, but I was still in love.
paragraphs.cue: But something slowly began to dawn on me: I still loved what I did. ______________________________ I’d been rejected, but I was still in love.

paragraphs.chinese: 于是，我决定重新开始。
paragraphs.english: And so I decided to start over.

paragraphs.chinese: 当时我没有意识到，但后来发现，被苹果解雇是我可能经历的最好的事情。
paragraphs.english: I didn’t see it then, but it turned out that getting fired from Apple was the best thing that could have ever happened to me.
paragraphs.cue: I didn’t see it then, but it turned out that ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 成功的沉重，被重新做一个新手的轻松取代了，尽管我对一切都不再那么确定。这让我得以进入人生中最有创造力的阶段之一。
paragraphs.english: The heaviness of being successful was replaced by the lightness of being a beginner again, less sure about everything. It freed me to enter one of the most creative periods of my life.
paragraphs.cue: The heaviness of being successful was replaced by the lightness of being a beginner again, less sure about everything. ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 接下来的五年里，我创办了 NeXT 和皮克斯，还爱上了一位后来成为我妻子的出色女性。
paragraphs.english: During the next five years, I started a company named NeXT, another company named Pixar, and fell in love with an amazing woman who would become my wife.
paragraphs.cue: During the next five years, I started a company named ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 皮克斯制作了世界上第一部电脑动画长片《玩具总动员》，如今已成为世界上最成功的动画工作室。
paragraphs.english: Pixar went on to create the world’s first computer-animated feature film, Toy Story, and is now the most successful animation studio in the world.
paragraphs.cue: Pixar went on to create the world’s first computer-animated feature ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 后来发生了奇妙的转折：苹果收购了 NeXT，我回到了苹果。我们在 NeXT 开发的技术，成了苹果当前复兴的核心。我和劳伦也一起拥有了一个美好的家庭。
paragraphs.english: In a remarkable turn of events, Apple bought NeXT, and I returned to Apple. And the technology we developed at NeXT is at the heart of Apple’s current renaissance. And Laurene and I have a wonderful family together.
paragraphs.cue: In a remarkable turn of events, Apple bought NeXT, and I returned to Apple. ______________________________ And Laurene and I have a wonderful family together.

paragraphs.chinese: 我很确定，如果没有被苹果解雇，这一切都不会发生。那是一剂苦药，但我想，病人确实需要它。
paragraphs.english: I’m pretty sure none of this would have happened if I hadn’t been fired from Apple. It was awful-tasting medicine, but I guess the patient needed it.
paragraphs.cue: I’m pretty sure none of this would have happened if I hadn’t been fired from Apple. ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 有时候，生活会像用砖头砸你的脑袋一样打击你。别失去信念。
paragraphs.english: Sometimes life’s gonna hit you in the head with a brick. Don’t lose faith.
paragraphs.cue: Sometimes life’s gonna hit you in the head with a brick. ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 我深信，唯一让我坚持下来的，是我热爱自己做的事。你必须找到自己热爱的东西，无论是工作还是爱人，都是如此。
paragraphs.english: I’m convinced that the only thing that kept me going was that I loved what I did. You’ve got to find what you love—and that is as true for work as it is for your lovers.
paragraphs.cue: I’m convinced that the only thing that kept me going was that I loved what I did. ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 工作会占据你人生很大一部分，真正满足的唯一方式，是做你认为出色的工作。
paragraphs.english: Your work is going to fill a large part of your life, and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work.
paragraphs.cue: Your work is going to fill a large part of ______________________________

paragraphs.chinese: 而做出出色工作的唯一方式，就是热爱你所做的事。
paragraphs.english: And the only way to do great work is to love what you do.
